title: American Casserole
description: A classic American comfort food dish, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook the casserole according to package instructions.
Chop the onion and sauté it in a pan until softened.
Add the awesome to the pan and stir to combine.
Combine the cooked casserole and onion mixture in a baking dish.
Top with the american and place in the oven.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
